definitions.explanation: An official report or statement made to authorities.
The act of filing taxes or declaring goods at customs.

examples.japanese: {申告|しんこく}{書|しょ}に{記入|きにゅう}する。
examples.english: To fill out a declaration form.
examples.notes: {申告|しんこく}{書|しょ} = declaration form

examples.japanese: {被害|ひがい}を{警察|けいさつ}に{申告|しんこく}した。
examples.english: I reported the damage to the police.

examples.japanese: {住所|じゅうしょ}が{変|か}わったら、{届|とど}け{出|で}を{申告|しんこく}しなければならない。
examples.english: If your address changes, you must file a notification.

examples.japanese: {確定|かくてい}{申告|しんこく}の{期限|きげん}は3{月|がつ}15{日|にち}だ。
examples.english: The deadline for filing tax returns is March 15th.
examples.notes: {確定|かくてい}{申告|しんこく} = final tax return

examples.japanese: {税関|ぜいかん}で{申告|しんこく}する{必要|ひつよう}がありますか。
examples.english: Do I need to make a declaration at customs?

examples.japanese: {所得|しょとく}を{正確|せいかく}に{申告|しんこく}しなければならない。
examples.english: You must accurately report your income.

notes:
Most commonly used in tax and customs contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{確定|かくてい}{申告|しんこく} (final tax return)
・{税関|ぜいかん}{申告|しんこく} (customs declaration)
・{所得|しょとく}{申告|しんこく} (income declaration)
・{申告|しんこく}{書|しょ} (declaration form)
・{申告|しんこく}{漏|も}れ (failure to report)

NOTE:
・{申告|しんこく} (しんこく) should not be confused with {深刻|しんこく} (serious, grave)
